latency_definition.limitation: Runs used different dates, output ceilings, and client scheduling.
latency_definition.measure: median end-to-end API latency per terminal persona-week call
latency_definition.scope: 2,853 coordinates per reasoning effort across three repeats

protocol_amendment.concurrency_note: Client concurrency changed after valid continuation receipts showed long xhigh wall time. It moved from 4 to 12 and then 24. This changes call scheduling only. Latency remains a diagnostic and is not directly comparable with Luna low.
protocol_amendment.continuation_rule: Preserve every initial receipt. Reuse only completed valid or fail-closed receipts. Retry incomplete and non-terminal error receipts at the amended ceiling.
protocol_amendment.execution_note: The initial executor waited for each complete batch. The final executor uses a continuous 24-worker pool so one long response does not stop new calls. The maximum number of concurrent calls is unchanged.
protocol_amendment.reason: The length-stratified smoke tests passed at 2,000 tokens, but the full runs produced incomplete max_output_tokens responses. The higher ceiling avoids measuring truncation instead of reasoning effort.
protocol_amendment.xhigh_reason: Two xhigh continuation calls reached 8,000 output tokens. The xhigh-only ceiling increased to 32,000. Medium and high remain at 8,000.

restrictions: Development-only AI-reviewed synthetic evidence; no human validation.
The complete development data is not a fresh final test.
The Weekly Drift Reviewer receives no VIF Critic input.
The smoke tests check execution, token limits, and cost only.
No prompt variant, final test, deployment approval, or runtime architecture change is tested.
